'''Teleother Falador''' is a [[standard spell]] where the caster [[teleport]]s a target, who must have [[Accept Aid]] turned on, to [[Falador]]. A window will pop for the person being teleported asking them if they wished to be teleported. It requires 82 [[Magic]] and yields 92 [[Magic]] experience.
